text: The clean, corporate sterility of the hallway and meeting room renders me distant and alert, as if standing at the threshold of potential dialogue and innovation. The transitional moment between spaces amplifies my sense of anticipation and observation. Stepping into the vibrant R+D exhibit, the colors, screens, and words invite a spirit of curiosity and engagement. Here, amidst a showcase of human inquiry, I feel drawn to contemplate the meaning and implications of development and research, sensing both inspiration and the subtle pressure to contribute my own thoughts to this continuum of idea-sharing.
